content: Please check the mailroom, the lobby or any other common areas.

metadata.title: My order hasn't arrived, but the status shows as delivered

content: Prescription orders take 7-10 business days because lenses are cut and fitted in our lab. Share the tracking link from the order page and confirm the lab completion date. If it is past 12 business days, escalate to the lab team.

metadata.title: It's been 10 days and my prescription glasses haven't shipped

content: Carrier scans can pause for up to 5 business days at regional hubs. Ask the customer to wait 2 more business days. If there is still no new scan, open a trace with the carrier and offer a free replacement shipment.

metadata.title: Tracking number hasn't updated in 5 days

content: Multi-item orders may ship in separate packages when items come from different warehouses. Check the order for more than one tracking number. If every package shows delivered and an item is still missing, reship it by express at no cost.

metadata.title: I only received part of my order

content: The shipping address can be changed only before the order status changes to Shipped. Update it in the admin panel. If the order has already shipped, request a carrier redirect, which may add 1-2 days.

metadata.title: Can I change my shipping address after placing the order?

content: We verify progressive prescriptions with the eye doctor before production, which takes 1-3 business days. Confirm the doctor's contact details are correct and that the prescription includes the PD and ADD values.

metadata.title: Order stuck on 'Awaiting prescription verification'

content: Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the return reaches our warehouse, and banks may take another 3-5 days to post them. Check the return scan date. If the refund was not issued, process it manually and send the confirmation email.

metadata.title: Still no refund for sunglasses I returned 2 weeks ago

content: Prescription lenses are covered by our 30-Day Fit Guarantee, so offer a free remake first. If the customer still prefers a refund, approve a full refund and email a prepaid return label.

metadata.title: I want a refund, my new glasses give me headaches

content: Unopened, unexpired contact lens boxes can be returned within 60 days for a full refund. Opened boxes cannot be returned for hygiene reasons. Offer store credit only if the box was damaged in shipping.

metadata.title: Can I return unopened boxes of contact lenses?

content: Check the payment record to tell a duplicate charge apart from a temporary authorization hold. Holds drop off in 3-7 days. Refund a duplicate charge right away and flag it to the payments team.

metadata.title: I was charged twice for my smart glasses

content: Have the customer update the SuperGlasses app, turn Bluetooth off and on, then hold the temple button for 10 seconds to reset pairing. If pairing still fails, collect the firmware version and phone model and escalate to tier 2.

metadata.title: My smart glasses won't pair with my phone

content: New bifocal wearers often need 1-2 weeks to get used to the lens line. If reading is still blurry after that, compare the segment height on the order with the customer's measurements, and offer a free remake if they don't match.

metadata.title: Reading is blurry with my new bifocals

content: Children's frames have a 1-year warranty against breakage. Ask for a photo of the damaged frame and send a free replacement. The customer does not need to return the broken pair.

metadata.title: My son's sunglasses frame broke after one week

content: Some blur at the sides is normal with progressive lenses, and most wearers adapt within 2 weeks. Advise turning the head instead of the eyes to look sideways. If the problem continues, offer a free upgrade to our wide-corridor progressive lens.

metadata.title: Things look distorted at the edges of my progressive lenses

content: A lens that pops out usually means the frame screw has come loose. Send a free repair kit or suggest a local optician tighten the screw. If the frame is bent, replace it under warranty.

metadata.title: A lens keeps popping out of my daughter's glasses

content: Password reset emails often land in spam or promotions folders. Confirm the account email, send a new reset link from the admin panel, and tell the customer the link expires after 30 minutes.

metadata.title: I can't reset my password

content: Go to My Account > Prescriptions and upload a photo or PDF of the prescription, or enter the values by hand. Prescriptions must be less than 2 years old, and the PD is required for single-vision orders.

metadata.title: How do I upload my prescription to my account?

content: Subscriptions can be paused or cancelled under My Account > Subscriptions up to 3 days before the next ship date. If the next order has already shipped, offer a return for a full refund.

metadata.title: How do I cancel my contact lens subscription?

content: We are in-network with VSP, EyeMed and Davis Vision for eligible plans, and other plans can be filed as out-of-network. Send the customer the reimbursement form link and remind them to keep the itemized receipt.

metadata.title: Do you accept vision insurance?

content: We fit new lenses into customer-owned frames that are in good condition. Send the customer a prepaid mailer; turnaround is 10-14 business days after we receive the frames.

metadata.title: Can you put new bifocal lenses in my own frames?

content: Orders with 3 or more pairs get 15% off automatically at checkout. Each family member can be added to the same order with their own prescription profile.

metadata.title: Is there a discount for buying glasses for the whole family?

content: For standard-tier customers, file a carrier claim and wait 5 business days for the carrier's response before reshipping. If the claim is approved or there is no update after 5 days, reship the order with free standard shipping (5-7 business days).

metadata.title: My package was lost in transit

content: For VIP customers, do not wait for the carrier claim: reship the lost order right away with free 2-day express shipping. File the carrier claim afterwards for our records.

metadata.title: The carrier lost my package

content: In-stock contact lenses ship within 1 business day and arrive in 5-7 business days with standard shipping. Standard shipping is free on orders over $49; below that it costs $5.95.

metadata.title: When will my contact lenses arrive?

content: The SuperGlasses Vue 300 (SKU SG-VUE-300) in black is back-ordered until mid-November 2026. Offer to keep the order open with priority shipping on release, or switch to the Vue 200 (SKU SG-VUE-200), which ships now.

metadata.title: Is the Vue 300 back in stock?

content: Progressive lenses take 10-14 business days from prescription verification to shipping because each lens is digitally surfaced. Adding the BlueShield blue-light coating adds 2 business days.

metadata.title: How long do progressive lenses take to make?

content: Standard-tier customers pay a $6.95 return label fee, deducted from the refund, for non-defective returns. Returns of defective or wrong items always get a free prepaid label.

metadata.title: Do I have to pay for return shipping?

content: Premium and VIP customers get a free prepaid return label on every return, defective or not. Generate the label from the order page and email it to the customer.

metadata.title: Is return shipping free?

content: Non-prescription sunglasses can be returned within 60 days if unworn and in the original case. Prescription sunglasses follow the 30-Day Fit Guarantee instead: free remake or refund within 30 days of delivery.

metadata.title: How long do I have to return my sunglasses?

content: Smart glasses can be returned within 30 days of delivery if all accessories and the charging case are included. After 30 days returns are not accepted; troubleshoot the issue or offer a warranty repair instead.

metadata.title: Can I return my smart glasses after 40 days?

content: When one pair from a multi-pair order is returned, the 15% multi-pair discount is recalculated. If fewer than 3 pairs remain, the lost discount is deducted from the refund; explain the calculation to the customer.

metadata.title: Why was my refund smaller than the price of the pair I returned?

content: VIP customers get a price adjustment if the price drops within 30 days of purchase. Refund the difference to the original payment method.

metadata.title: The price dropped right after I bought my glasses

content: Standard and premium customers get a price adjustment only if the price drops within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days, offer a 10% coupon for the next order instead.

metadata.title: Can I get the difference back now that my glasses are on sale?

content: Lenses with the AR-Pro anti-reflective coating are covered against scratches for 12 months. Ask for a photo and send replacement lenses for the same frame at no cost.

metadata.title: My lenses got scratched after a few months

content: Uncoated lenses are not covered for scratches. Offer 40% off a replacement pair of lenses and suggest adding the AR-Pro coating, which includes 12-month scratch coverage.

metadata.title: Scratches on my lenses, is this covered?

content: The Vue 200 (SKU SG-VUE-200) charges with a magnetic cable on the right temple. Clean the gold contacts with a dry cloth and charge for 30 minutes; if the LED still doesn't light up, send a free replacement cable.

metadata.title: My Vue 200 won't charge

content: The Vue 300 (SKU SG-VUE-300) charges only inside its USB-C charging case. Check that the case is charged (4 LEDs) and the glasses sit with the hinges fully folded; if they still don't charge, start a warranty replacement.

metadata.title: My Vue 300 stopped charging

content: A full charge lasts about 6 hours of audio use on the Vue 300 and 4 hours on the Vue 200. Turn off always-on voice wake in the app; if battery life is under half of that, replace under the 1-year warranty (2 years with CarePlus).

metadata.title: Smart glasses battery drains too fast

content: Check that the base curve and diameter shipped match the prescription on file. If they match, advise the customer to see their eye doctor, and offer a one-time exchange of unopened boxes for a different brand.

metadata.title: My new contact lenses feel dry and uncomfortable

content: This is normal with polarized lenses, which block light from some screens when tilted. If the customer needs to read screens outdoors, offer an exchange for non-polarized lenses within 60 days.

metadata.title: My phone screen looks black through my sunglasses

content: Adult frames have a 12-month warranty against defects for standard and premium customers. Ask for a photo of the defect and send a prepaid mailer so we can move the lenses into a new frame for free.

metadata.title: The hinge on my frame broke

content: VIP customers get a 24-month frame warranty. Send a replacement frame with new lenses right away by 2-day express; the customer does not need to send the old pair back.

metadata.title: My frame snapped at the bridge

content: Customers can change their email under My Account > Profile, and a verification code is sent to the new address. If they no longer have access to the old email, verify identity with the last order number and billing ZIP code.

metadata.title: How do I change the email on my account?

content: Customers move to Premium after spending $300 in 12 months and to VIP after $750 in 12 months. Tiers are reviewed on the 1st of each month and stay valid for 12 months.

metadata.title: How do I become a VIP customer?

content: Uploads are rejected when the prescription is more than 2 years old, unsigned, or missing the PD. Ask for a new photo with all four corners visible; files must be JPG, PNG or PDF under 10 MB.

metadata.title: My prescription upload keeps getting rejected

content: Smart glasses can be linked to one SuperGlasses account at a time. Ask the previous owner to remove the device under App > Devices, or factory reset the glasses by holding the temple button for 20 seconds (10 seconds only resets Bluetooth pairing).

metadata.title: I bought used smart glasses and can't add them to my account

content: We ship to the US and Canada only. Canadian orders take 7-10 business days, and the customer pays any duties on delivery.

metadata.title: Do you ship internationally?

content: Prescription glasses, prescription sunglasses and contact lenses are FSA/HSA eligible, and customers can pay with their FSA/HSA card at checkout. Non-prescription sunglasses and smart glasses are not eligible.

metadata.title: Can I pay with my FSA or HSA card?

content: Our Home Try-On program sends 5 frames free for 7 days, and VIP customers can request up to 8 frames. Home Try-On is not available for smart glasses.

metadata.title: Can I try frames at home before buying?

content: Children's prescription glasses include one free replacement pair within 12 months for loss or breakage, on top of the frame warranty. The replacement uses the same prescription as the original order.

metadata.title: Do kids' glasses come with a free replacement if they get lost?

content: All SuperGlasses sunglasses, including kids' sizes, block 100% of UVA and UVB rays (UV400). Kids' frames come in sizes XS and S for ages 3-12.

metadata.title: Do your kids' sunglasses have UV protection?

content: Standard-tier customers can upgrade to 2-day express shipping for $14.95 at checkout. Express only speeds up delivery; lab production time for prescription lenses stays the same.

metadata.title: How much does express shipping cost?

content: Premium customers get free 2-day express shipping on orders over $99; below $99, express costs $14.95. Lab production time for prescription lenses stays the same.

metadata.title: Do I get free express shipping?

content: Prescription orders can be cancelled for a full refund within 2 hours of purchase, before the lens lab starts work. After that, the customer can return the glasses under the 30-Day Fit Guarantee once they arrive.

metadata.title: Can I cancel my prescription glasses order?

content: Orders without prescription lenses can be cancelled any time before the status changes to Shipped. Cancel the order in the admin panel; the refund posts in 3-5 business days.

metadata.title: Can I cancel my sunglasses order?

content: Ask standard-tier customers to check with neighbors and wait 48 hours, since carriers sometimes mark packages delivered early. After 48 hours, have them sign the lost-package statement in their account and reship with standard shipping.

metadata.title: Package says delivered but it's not here

content: For VIP customers, if a delivered package isn't found after 48 hours, reship right away by 2-day express. Ask the customer to sign the lost-package statement in their account.

metadata.title: Tracking says delivered but I never got my package

content: Canadian orders held at customs are usually released within 3-5 business days. The customer pays any duties; if they refuse the package, the refund excludes the original shipping cost.

metadata.title: My order to Canada is stuck in customs

content: AquaView Daily lenses stronger than -6.00 are back-ordered for 2-3 weeks. Confirm the customer agreed to a split shipment; the second eye's boxes ship free as soon as they're in stock.

metadata.title: Only one eye's contact lenses shipped

content: Bifocal lenses take 8-12 business days to make after prescription verification. If the order is past 14 business days, escalate to the lab team and offer free express shipping.

metadata.title: When will my bifocals ship?

content: Items can be added to an order only within 2 hours of purchase, before it reaches the lab. After that, place a new order; the 15% multi-pair discount applies only to pairs in the same order.

metadata.title: Can I add another pair to my existing order?

content: Orders paid with a gift card are refunded as store credit, not cash. Store credit never expires and appears in My Account > Wallet within 1 business day.

metadata.title: I paid with a gift card, how do I get my refund?

content: If a customer can't adapt to bifocals within the 30-Day Fit Guarantee, offer a switch to progressive lenses (they pay only the price difference) or a full refund.

metadata.title: I can't get used to my bifocals and want my money back

content: Within 30 days, customers who can't adapt to progressive lenses can switch to two single-vision pairs or get a full refund under the 30-Day Fit Guarantee. After 30 days, offer 25% off a remake instead.

metadata.title: Refund for progressive lenses I can't adapt to

content: If insurance benefits are approved after the customer paid full price, refund the covered amount within 5 business days of receiving the insurer's payment. Confirm the claim number before issuing the refund.

metadata.title: My insurance was approved after I paid full price

content: If a valid coupon didn't apply at checkout, refund the coupon value to the original payment method within 14 days of purchase. Expired coupons cannot be honored.

metadata.title: My coupon code didn't apply at checkout

content: Kids' prescription glasses follow the same 30-Day Fit Guarantee as adult glasses. If the child's prescription changes within 6 months of the order, remake the lenses at 50% off.

metadata.title: My child's prescription changed two months after we ordered

content: If an auto-refill shipped the wrong lens power, send the correct lenses free by express and email a prepaid label for the wrong boxes. Give a full refund instead if the customer prefers.

metadata.title: My auto-refill sent the wrong lens power

content: CarePlus can be cancelled for a full refund within 30 days of purchase if no claim was made. After 30 days, refund the unused months pro-rated.

metadata.title: Can I cancel the CarePlus plan I bought?

content: VIP customers have a 45-day return window on smart glasses, compared with 30 days for other tiers. All accessories and the charging case must be included.

metadata.title: Can I still return my smart glasses after 35 days?

content: Worn non-prescription sunglasses cannot be returned for a refund. If they have a defect, handle it under the 12-month frame warranty instead.

metadata.title: I wore my sunglasses once, can I still return them?

content: On the Vue 300, check that Volume Boost is on in the app under Audio, and clean the speaker grilles near the temples with a soft brush. Firmware 3.2 or later fixes a known low-volume bug.

metadata.title: Sound on my Vue 300 is too quiet

content: The Vue 200 has no Volume Boost setting; maximum volume is controlled by the phone. Make sure the phone's media volume is up and the glasses run firmware 2.8 or later.

metadata.title: Sound on my Vue 200 is too quiet

content: Touch controls on the Vue 300 stop responding when the temples are wet. Dry the temples, then restart the glasses by holding the temple button for 3 seconds.

metadata.title: Touch controls on my Vue 300 stopped working

content: Check that the fitting height on the order matches the customer's measurement. A difference of more than 2 mm qualifies for a free remake.

metadata.title: The reading area of my progressive lenses is too small

content: The visible line and image jump when looking down are normal with lined bifocals. If the customer dislikes them, offer a switch to progressive lenses under the 30-Day Fit Guarantee.

metadata.title: There's a visible line in my bifocals and things jump when I look down

content: A slight yellow tint is normal with BlueShield blue-light lenses. If the customer needs accurate color vision, offer a free switch to AR-Pro lenses without BlueShield within 30 days.

metadata.title: Everything looks slightly yellow with my blue-light glasses

content: SunShift light-adaptive lenses react to UV light, and most car windshields block UV, so they won't darken while driving. Recommend prescription sunglasses for driving.

metadata.title: My light-adaptive lenses don't darken in the car

content: A lens torn inside a sealed blister is a manufacturing defect. Send one free replacement box of the same power, and ask the customer for the lot number printed on the box.

metadata.title: A contact lens was torn when I opened the package

content: Any optician can adjust most frames for free, or we can send free adjustable nose pads for metal frames. Acetate frames without nose pads can't be adjusted at home.

metadata.title: My glasses keep sliding down my nose

content: Bent kids' frames are covered by the 1-year warranty. FlexFit kids' frames can usually be bent back by hand; if not, send a free replacement.

metadata.title: My son bent his glasses

content: Colors can look different on screens. Accept an exchange for another color within 30 days, with free shipping both ways.

metadata.title: The frame color doesn't match the website photo

content: If the lenses don't match the prescription on the order, it's a lab error. Remake them free with 2-day express shipping for every tier, and send a prepaid label for the incorrect pair.

metadata.title: My new glasses were made with the wrong prescription

content: If a multi-item package has the wrong frame, ship the correct item by 2-day express at no cost and send a prepaid label for the wrong one. Check the other items in the order for the same picking error.

metadata.title: I received the wrong frame in my order

content: Both Vue models accept single-vision prescription lenses from -6.00 to +4.00. Progressive and bifocal lenses are not available for smart glasses.

metadata.title: Can I get prescription lenses in my smart glasses?

content: Account deletion is requested under My Account > Privacy and completes within 30 days. Order history is kept for 7 years for tax purposes, and any store credit is lost.

metadata.title: How do I delete my account?

content: Verify the customer's identity with the last order number and billing ZIP code, then remove 2-step verification so they can sign in. Remind them to turn it back on under My Account > Security.

metadata.title: I lost my phone and can't get the 2-step verification code

content: Tiers are reviewed on the 1st of each month based on spending in the last 12 months. Customers drop from VIP to Premium if spending falls below $750, but VIP benefits still apply to orders already placed.

metadata.title: Why did my tier drop from VIP to Premium?

content: Up to 6 family member profiles can be added under My Account > Family, each with its own prescription. Orders for family members count toward the account holder's tier spending.

metadata.title: How do I add my family to my account?

content: Saved prescriptions are marked expired after 2 years and can't be used for new orders. The customer can upload a new one, or give us the clinic's phone number and we'll contact their eye doctor.

metadata.title: My saved prescription shows as expired

content: Payment methods are updated under My Account > Subscriptions > Payment. A declined payment is retried after 3 days, and the subscription pauses after 2 failed attempts.

metadata.title: My card was declined for my contact lens subscription

content: Accounts can't be merged automatically, but support can move order history and prescriptions into one account. Tier spending is combined at the next monthly review.

metadata.title: I have two accounts, can you merge them?

content: Customers who signed up with Google sign in with the Sign in with Google button and have no separate password. To add one, use Forgot password with the same email.

metadata.title: I signed up with Google and don't have a password

content: Digital gift cards come in values from $25 to $500, are delivered by email, and never expire. They can't be used to buy other gift cards.

metadata.title: Do you sell gift cards?

content: SuperGlasses is online only and has no retail stores. Customers can use Home Try-On or the virtual try-on tool on each product page.

metadata.title: Do you have a store I can visit?

content: We don't provide eye exams; customers need a valid prescription from an eye doctor. Contact lenses need a separate contact lens prescription that lists the brand and base curve.

metadata.title: Can I get an eye exam through SuperGlasses?

content: Students and military members get 10% off after verifying through our ID check partner. It can't be combined with the 15% multi-pair discount; the larger discount applies.

metadata.title: Do you have a student or military discount?

content: Customers can measure their PD with the ruler tool in our app or ask their eye doctor. Single-vision orders need one PD, while progressive and bifocal orders need two monocular PDs.

metadata.title: How do I measure my PD?

content: Customers can mail old glasses to our ReSee recycling program using any SuperGlasses return label. Each donated pair earns a $10 coupon, up to 3 per year.

metadata.title: What can I do with my old glasses?

content: We don't sell ANSI Z87 safety glasses. Our sports sunglasses use impact-resistant polycarbonate but are not certified for workplace safety.

metadata.title: Are your sports sunglasses safe for work?

content: The Vue 300 microphones record only after the wake word or a temple tap, and audio is processed on the phone. Customers can delete their voice history in the app under Privacy.

metadata.title: Are my smart glasses always listening?
